# Phase 6: spend guard (version 1.57.0; coordinator owns the version bump and CHANGELOG)

Goal: runs stop launching new work at a cap, let in-flight jobs finish, never spend over a cap without an explicit raise, pause on quota exhaustion, run a zero-model idle menu while paused, and resume exactly where they left off. The usage ledger is written automatically.

## A. tools/spend.mjs (new, pure where possible, dependency-free ESM)

Exports (exact names):

- `LANE_DAILY_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({ openrouter: Object.freeze({ dailyUsd: 5 }) })`.
- `resolveBudget({ config = {}, manifest = {}, cli = {}, raises = [] })` -> `{ maxUsd, maxTokens, lanes: { <agent>: { dailyUsd, dailyTokens } } }` (missing caps are `null`).
  - Run caps: `manifest.budget.maxUsd` / `manifest.budget.maxTokens`, overridden by `cli.maxUsd` / `cli.maxTokens`.
  - Lane daily caps: start from `LANE_DAILY_DEFAULTS`, then `config.spend.lanes.<agent>` (may raise or lower), then `manifest.budget.lanes.<agent>` (may only lower: effective = min of the two when both set).
  - `raises` = `[{ key, value, reason, at }]` applied last, in order. Keys: `maxUsd`, `maxTokens`, `lane.<agent>.dailyUsd`, `lane.<agent>.dailyTokens`. A raise value must be greater than the current effective value (or the cap is null), else throw code `budget-raise-invalid`.
  - Validation: every cap is null or a finite number > 0 (tokens: positive integer); unknown keys or agents (use LANE_AGENTS from tools/lanes.mjs) throw code `budget-invalid` with message `budget-invalid: <path> <reason>`.
- `jobSpend(record)` -> `{ usd: number|null, tokens: number|null }` from `record.costUsd` and `record.usage.total_tokens`.
- `runTotals(state)` -> `{ usd, tokens, unknownUsd: [jobIds with tokens but no cost] }` summing every job record (complete or not) that has spend.
- `laneDailyTotals(states, { now = () => new Date(), excludeRunId })` -> `{ <agent>: { usd, tokens } }`: sums jobs whose `finishedAt` is at/after today's UTC midnight, keyed by `record.agent`, skipping the run with id `excludeRunId`.
- `capDecision({ budget, run, laneToday, agent })` -> `null` or `{ reason: 'run-cap'|'lane-cap', key, spent, cap, message }`. Run cap hit when `run.usd >= maxUsd` or `run.tokens >= maxTokens`. Lane cap hit when `laneToday[agent].usd >= dailyUsd` or tokens >= dailyTokens. Message shape: `spend-cap: run spent $<usd> >= maxUsd $<cap>; resume with --raise maxUsd=<N> --reason TEXT` (tokens and lanes analogous, e.g. `spend-cap: lane openrouter spent $5.01 today >= dailyUsd $5; resume with --raise lane.openrouter.dailyUsd=<N> --reason TEXT`). USD formatting: 2 decimals.
- Ledger:
  - `ledgerRows(state, { phase = '-' })` -> rows `{ key, date, phase, task, worker, model, result, tokens, cost }`, one per attempt in `record.attempts` (key `<runId>/<jobId>#<n>`, n = 1-based attempt index). The last attempt carries the record's tokens and cost; earlier attempts show tokens `-`. `task` = `<jobId>: <report summary or first prompt line>` sanitized (strip `|`, newlines, control chars), max 100 chars. `result` = `pass` for complete, else `<status>: <error first 60 chars>`. `tokens` = thousands-separated integer or `-`. `cost` = `$x.xx` when costUsd is a number; `subscription` for codex, cursor, claude, hermes, qwen; else `unknown`. `date` = attempt finishedAt UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).
  - `mergeLedger(text, rows)` -> new markdown text. If `text` is empty or has no ledger table, create the header `# Usage ledger`, a one-line description, and the table header `| date | phase | task | worker | model | result | tokens | rough cost |`. Append rows after the last table row of the first table. Then rewrite the `## Daily summary` section (create if missing) from ALL rows of the first table: header `| date | tier | calls | pass | fail/blocked | tokens | rough cost |`, one row per (date, worker) in date then worker order. calls = row count, pass = rows whose result starts with `pass`, fail/blocked = the rest, tokens = sum of numeric tokens, cost = `$x.xx` sum if any row has a $ cost, else `subscription` if any row is subscription, else `unknown`. Everything after the daily summary table is preserved.
- Idle menu: `async runIdleMenu(root, { runId, items, baseCommit, until = null, now = Date.now, spawnImpl = spawn, gitImpl })` -> `[{ name, status: 'committed'|'unchanged'|'failed'|'timeout'|'skipped', branch, exitCode, commit, error }]`.
  - `items` = `[{ name, argv, timeoutMs }]`, name `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$`, argv non-empty string array, timeoutMs integer 1000..3600000 (default 600000). `validateIdleItems(items)` exported; throws code `idle-invalid`.
  - Each item, in order, while `until === null || now() < until`: branch `idle/<runId>/<name>`. If the branch already exists, status `skipped` with error `idle-branch-exists`. Otherwise `git worktree add -b <branch> <dir> <baseCommit>` with dir `<root>/.swarm/idle/<runId>/<name>`; run argv in that dir with env limited to `{ PATH, HOME, LANG, TMPDIR }` from process.env plus `SWARM_IDLE=1` (nothing else: no keys, no tokens), timeout = min(timeoutMs, until - now()). Then if `git status --porcelain` is non-empty: `git add -A` and commit with `-c user.name=swarm-idle -c user.email=swarm-idle@localhost commit -m "idle: <name>"` -> `committed` with sha; else `unchanged`. Always `git worktree remove --force <dir>` afterwards (the branch stays). Never checkout, reset, push, or touch any branch outside `idle/`; never call a model.
  - Results are also written to `.swarm/runs/<runId>/idle.json` (append to an array of `{ at, results }`).

## B. Runner wiring (tools/swarm.mjs, tools/monitor-view.mjs)

- Manifest fields (validated; unknown keys refused like other manifest fields): `budget: { maxUsd?, maxTokens?, lanes?: { <agent>: { dailyUsd?, dailyTokens? } } }`, `idle: [items]`, `ledger: { path?, phase? }`. Config (`loadLocalConfig`): `spend.lanes`, `idle`, `ledger.path`. Manifest `idle` replaces config `idle` when present.
- `runManifest` options: `maxUsd`, `maxTokens`, `now`, `sleep` (injectable for tests). CLI: `run MANIFEST [--max-usd N] [--max-tokens N] [--wait-quota]`.
- Run start: save `state.budget` (resolved), `state.snapshotHashes` (the existing per-file snapshot hash map, as an object), and `state.ledger` settings.
- Gate: in `runOne`, after `scheduler.acquire` succeeds and before `prepare`: compute `capDecision` with this run's in-memory totals and lane daily totals (other runs read from `.swarm/runs/*/state.json` of this root, plus this run in memory). For `agent: auto` jobs, a lane at its daily cap reports health state `paused` to `pickJobRoute` so routing moves to the next cheap lane; a held decision happens only for the lane actually chosen. If a cap is hit: release the slot, set the record `status: 'held'`, `heldReason` = the decision reason, `error` = the decision message, no attempt recorded, no workspace prepared. Jobs already running keep running and their results are recorded normally.
- Quota: a job refused because its lane pause exceeds `maxPauseMs` keeps today's `provider-limit` status and error, and also gets `heldReason: 'quota'` and `heldUntil` (the lane's until ISO). A job whose own attempt ended quota-exhausted (and is not re-routed) also gets `heldReason: 'quota'` and `heldUntil`.
- Dependents (`after`) of a held job stay `queued` (they are not cascaded to `skipped`) and get `heldReason: 'after <id> held'`.
- Run end: if any job has `heldReason`, write `state.pause = { reasons: [unique reasons], until: latest heldUntil or null, message, jobs: [held ids], at }`. `state.status = 'paused'` when every non-complete job has `heldReason`; otherwise the existing status logic. The CLI `run` and `resume` exit with code 75 when the result is paused.
- `export async function resumeRun(root, id, { raises = [], reason, wait = false, now, sleep, ...runOptions })` and CLI `resume RUN [--raise KEY=VALUE ...] [--reason TEXT] [--wait]`:
  - Refuses unless status is `paused` (code `resume-not-paused`). `--raise` requires `--reason` (code `budget-raise-reason`). Raises are appended to `state.budgetRaises` with reason and time, then `resolveBudget` is recomputed with them.
  - For any held job whose reason is a cap still hit under the new budget: refuse `resume-over-cap: <decision message>` with nothing launched. The runner never raises a cap by itself.
  - Quota holds with `pause.until` in the future: without `wait` refuse `resume-too-early: resets at <until>; pass --wait`. With `wait`: run the idle menu (items from manifest/config; none -> skip with warning `idle-menu-empty`) with `until = pause.until`, then `sleep(until - now())`, then continue.
  - Resume re-checks every snapshot file against `state.snapshotHashes`; a mismatch refuses `resume-snapshot-changed: <file>`.
  - It then dispatches exactly the jobs with `heldReason` (and their queued dependents once their dependencies complete), in manifest order, reusing the same run id, directory, records, base hashes and worktrees base. Complete jobs are not touched: their records (attempts, timestamps, report, workspace files) stay byte-identical. Held jobs have `heldReason`, `heldUntil`, and `error` cleared when dispatched. The run claim file must not block resume. The same caps, gate, quota and pause logic apply during the resumed dispatch, so a resume can pause again.
  - `run --wait-quota`: when a run ends paused only for quota, the CLI loops `resumeRun(..., { wait: true })` until it is not paused for quota (max 24 loops).
- Ledger: when a run (or resume) finishes in any state, append `ledgerRows` for attempts not yet written to the ledger file with `mergeLedger`, and record written keys in `state.ledgerKeys` so rows are never duplicated. Path: manifest `ledger.path`, else config `ledger.path`, else `docs/state/usage-ledger.md` if that file exists, else `.swarm/usage-ledger.md`. Validation refuses a manifest where any job output equals the ledger path (code `ledger-is-output`). A ledger write failure becomes run warning `ledger-write-failed: <message>`, never a run failure. CLI `ledger RUN` writes any missing rows for an existing run (idempotent) and prints `{ path, added }`.
- CLI `idle RUN` runs the idle menu now (no until) and prints the results.
- integrate refuses a paused run with code `run-paused`: `run-paused: resume <id> first`.
- `monitor --view` (monitor-view.mjs) adds a line `paused: <reasons> until <until|n/a>; held <n> (<first ids>)` when `state.pause` is set.
- Keep existing behavior and tests green: the existing `spendGuard` daily cap, `--over-cap`, and claude provider-limit marker are unchanged.

## Tests

- tests/spend.test.mjs (job A): resolveBudget precedence, lowering-only manifest lanes, raises (valid, not-greater refused), validation codes; runTotals; laneDailyTotals UTC midnight and excludeRunId; capDecision messages; ledgerRows (attempt keys, sanitizing, cost column); mergeLedger (creates file, appends, recomputes summary, preserves trailing text, idempotent when rows are pre-filtered); runIdleMenu in a temp git repo: commits on `idle/<run>/<name>`, unchanged item, failing item, timeout, `idle-branch-exists`, main branch HEAD and working tree unchanged, env has no variable outside the allowed list (assert via an item that dumps env to a file), worktree removed.
- tests/spend-run.test.mjs (job B), with stub API workers (ollama fetchImpl, as in tests/lanes-run.test.mjs) and temp liveDir/config:

  - Lane daily cap: an earlier run today spent $5 on openrouter -> a `sensitive: false` openrouter job is held with lane-cap; an auto job routes to the next cheap lane instead.
  - Resume exactness: after the run-cap pause, `resumeRun` without raise refuses `resume-over-cap`; with `--raise maxUsd=5 --reason x` it dispatches exactly the 2 held jobs (fetch calls only for those ids), completes the run, complete records from the first pass are deep-equal to before, `budgetRaises` recorded, and ledger rows are not duplicated.
  - Quota: a job's lane hits 402 with resetsAt in the future -> paused with until; resume without wait refuses `resume-too-early`; with `wait` and injected now/sleep, the idle menu runs (an item commits on `idle/<run>/<name>`, root HEAD unchanged), sleep is called with the remaining time, then held jobs complete.
  - Dependents of a held job stay queued and run on resume.
  - Snapshot changed between pause and resume refuses `resume-snapshot-changed`.
  - Ledger: written to `.swarm/usage-ledger.md` by default in a fixture, to `docs/state/usage-ledger.md` when it exists; `ledger-is-output` refusal; `ledger RUN` idempotent.
  - integrate on a paused run refuses `run-paused`.

=== FIXES CONTRACT (implement now) ===
# #96 review fixes: machine-wide daily spend, launch reservations, no $0 paid jobs (still 1.57.0)

Paid lanes: `PAID_LANES = ['openrouter', 'openai', 'gemini', 'lambda']` (exported from tools/spend.mjs). Every other lane is unpaid for USD purposes (its tokens still count toward token caps).

## 1. Machine-wide daily spend store (tools/spend.mjs)

- `spendDir(env = process.env, home = os.homedir())` = `env.SWARM_SPEND_DIR || <home>/.project-swarm/spend`. File `daily.json`, lock dir `daily.lock`.
- File shape: `{ version: 1, entries: { <key>: { day, lane, runId, root, jobId, usd, tokens, kind, pid, host, at, flagged } } }`. `kind` is `reservation` | `actual` | `estimated` | `reserved-as-cost`. `day` is the UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the entry was first written. Keys are `<sha256(root) first 12 hex>/<runId>/<jobId>#<attempt>`.
- `async withSpendStore(fn, { dir, now, isAlive, timeoutMs = 10000 })`: take the lock with `mkdir`, writing `owner.json` `{ pid, host, at }`. A stale lock is cleared and the lock retried. Stale means: same host with a dead pid, or no `owner.json` and older than 60 s. Otherwise poll every 25 ms until `timeoutMs`, then throw code `spend-store-locked`. Under the lock:
  - read the file (missing means empty; malformed throws code `spend-store-invalid` and is never overwritten);
  - call `fn(store)`, where `fn` may mutate `store.entries` and return a value;
  - write atomically (temp file, fsync, rename) only if it changed;
  - release the lock.
  - Also, under the lock, prune entries whose day is more than 31 days before today.
  - Convert `reservation` entries owned by a dead pid on this host to `reserved-as-cost` with `flagged: true`. A crashed job may have spent.
- `laneDayTotals(store, { day })` -> `{ <lane>: { usd, tokens } }` summing every entry of that day (all kinds, reservations included).
- `laneDailyTotals` from the earlier version is no longer used by the runner (it can stay exported for compatibility).

## 2. Reservations (tools/spend.mjs)

- `estimateReservation({ job, lane, model, inputChars, rates, laneDefaults })` -> `{ usd, tokens, source }`:
  - `maxOut = job.maxOutputTokens ?? (lane === 'openrouter' ? defaultMaxOutputTokens(model) : 8192)` (import `defaultMaxOutputTokens` from ./openrouter.mjs).
  - `tokens = maxOut + Math.ceil(inputChars / 4)` for every lane.
  - USD, for paid lanes only (else 0, source `unpaid`), first match wins:
    a. `job.maxCredits` together with a rate `creditUsd` gives maxCredits times creditUsd; source `max-credits`.
    b. A rate `{ inUsdPerToken, outUsdPerToken }` gives inputChars times inUsdPerToken plus maxOut times outUsdPerToken (every char counted as a token: worst case); source `rate`.
    c. The per-lane default `laneDefaults[lane]` gives `reserveUsd`; source `lane-default`.
  - `rates` is the resolved rate for this job's model (see B), possibly null.
- `LANE_RESERVE_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({ openrouter: 0.5, openai: 0.5, gemini: 0.5, lambda: 0.5 })` (USD). These can be overridden by config `spend.lanes.<agent>.reserveUsd`, which resolveBudget must accept (positive finite) and expose as `budget.lanes.<agent>.reserveUsd`.
- `async reserveSpend({ dir, key, lane, runId, root, jobId, usd, tokens, budget, runTotals, now, isAlive })`: inside `withSpendStore`:
  - compute today's lane totals (including all reservations, from every project);
  - call `capDecision({ budget, run: runTotals, laneToday, agent: lane })`, where `runTotals` is supplied by the caller and already includes this run's in-flight reservations;
  - if it returns a decision, write nothing and return `{ decision }`;
  - otherwise write the entry with kind `reservation` and return `{ decision: null }`.
  - So admission happens while the totals are below the cap, and the day can overshoot by at most one reservation, plus actual-over-estimate.
- `async settleSpend({ dir, key, usd, tokens, kind, flagged, now })`: inside `withSpendStore`, replace the entry's usd/tokens/kind/flagged (keeping its day). `releaseSpend({ dir, key })` deletes the entry. Both are no-ops for a missing key.
- `finalCost({ lane, record, reservation, rates })` -> `{ usd, kind, flagged, costSource }`:
  - `record.costUsd` is a number: `{ usd: costUsd, kind: 'actual', flagged: false, costSource: record.costSource ?? 'reported' }`.
  - Unpaid lane: `{ usd: 0, kind: 'actual', flagged: false, costSource: null }` (never flagged).
  - Paid lane with input and/or output tokens in `record.usage` (input_tokens|prompt_tokens, output_tokens|completion_tokens) and a rate: usd = input tokens times inUsdPerToken plus output tokens times outUsdPerToken, kind `estimated`, flagged true, costSource `estimated-from-tokens`.
  - Otherwise (paid): `usd = reservation.usd`, kind `reserved-as-cost`, flagged true, costSource `reservation`.
  - A paid job is never $0 unless the provider reported 0.

## 3. Ledger and rollup flags

- `ledgerRows`:
  - cost cell `$x.xx` for actual;
  - `$x.xx est` when `record.costSource === 'estimated-from-tokens'`;
  - `$x.xx reserved` when `record.costSource === 'reservation'`.
- `mergeLedger` daily summary sums all three. If any are est/reserved, the cost cell is `$x.xx (incl. estimates)`.
- tools/reports.mjs `rollupRun`: `spend.estimatedJobs` (ids whose costSource is `estimated-from-tokens` or `reservation`). `renderRollupText` appends ` - estimated cost for N jobs` to the spend line when N > 0. Keep the rollup under 4096 bytes.

## B. Runner wiring (tools/swarm.mjs)

- Lane daily totals for capDecision come only from the spend store (`laneDayTotals`), never from `.swarm/runs`. So deleting a project's `.swarm` cannot reset them, and every project on the machine shares them. The routing health check for auto jobs uses the same store totals.
- Rates: config `spend.rates.<model>` = `{ inUsdPerToken, outUsdPerToken, creditUsd? }`; resolveBudget-style validation with code `budget-invalid`. For openrouter without a configured rate, fetch the public pricing with `fetchPricing(model, { fetchImpl })` from ./openrouter.mjs, cached per run per model. If that fetch fails, use the lane default (no rate).
- At launch (where the current cap gate is):
  - compute `inputChars` = prompt length + the byte sizes of the job's context and output files at root;
  - estimate the reservation;
  - the run totals passed in = recorded run spend plus this run's other in-flight reservations (an in-memory map);
  - call `reserveSpend` with key attempt n = `record.attempts.length + 1`.
  - A decision holds the job exactly as today (status `held`, no attempt).
  - Unpaid lanes also reserve (usd 0, token estimate), so token caps work the same way.
- After the attempt finishes (every path, including failure, timeout, cancel and retry):
  - if the job never reached the adapter (refused before start, setupFailed, prepare failed), call `releaseSpend`;
  - otherwise compute `finalCost` and `settleSpend`. If the record had no costUsd, set `record.costUsd = usd` and `record.costSource = costSource` for paid lanes.
  - Remove it from the in-flight map.
- Run totals for caps (`runTotals`) therefore include estimated and reserved costs.
- `resumeRun`'s over-cap check uses store totals too.
- Tests must point `SWARM_SPEND_DIR` at a temp dir (pass via `env`; the runner reads `env.SWARM_SPEND_DIR`).

## Tests

- tests/spend.test.mjs:
  - store: lock, stale lock cleared, `spend-store-locked` timeout, malformed file refused and untouched, prune, dead-pid reservation becomes `reserved-as-cost`;
  - estimateReservation sources a/b/c and unpaid;
  - finalCost for all four cases;
  - ledger and rollup flags.
  - Concurrency: 8 child processes (`node -e` importing tools/spend.mjs) each call `reserveSpend` 8 times at $0.5 with a $5 lane cap. Exactly 10 entries are admitted and the file stays valid JSON.
- tests/spend-run.test.mjs (update the earlier lane-cap test to seed the store instead of an earlier run):
  - Two roots: a run in root A spends $5 on openrouter (stub). A run in root B (its own `.swarm`, same `SWARM_SPEND_DIR`) is held with lane-cap. After `rm -rf rootA/.swarm`, a new run in B is still held.
  - 64 concurrent openrouter jobs (manifest concurrency 64, `sensitive: false`, fake key, stub fetch: pricing URL returns rates so each reservation is $0.50; completions report cost $0.45 after a short delay). The day total in the store ends ≤ $5 + $0.50. The calls that reached the completion endpoint are ≤ 11. The rest are held.
  - Paid job with no reported cost but tokens: costUsd is estimated from the tokens, costSource `estimated-from-tokens`, and the ledger cell is `est`. With no tokens: costUsd = reservation, costSource `reservation`, the ledger cell is `reserved`, and rollup `estimatedJobs` includes it. Never 0.
  - A job refused before start releases its reservation.
